physical_meaning: The live handoff may consume only fresh profile-generated queues, never stale _handoff or 0624/migration queue files.
New-algorithm supplemental points run inside their mature temperature segments without changing the legacy 45/13 default.
The physical route stays mature; only fitting changes from R to A/R0(T), with pressure calibrated first and temperature coefficients neutral.
The handoff must not consume _handoff, root migration, 0624, diagnostic, or worker-as-top-level queue sources.
Both algorithms use the same reviewed 0620/0621 queue and point-worker implementation; the profile does not fork physical actions.
This package is an offline contract only and cannot open COM, control routes, write analyzers, import PostgreSQL, or release a run.
